meta.title: Recurring PO: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Select or identify a Growth-plan tenant and an Enterprise-plan tenant for comparison
Open and use the Recurring PO capability to configure an automatic PO-generation schedule
Assert that Recurring PO is absent or refused on Growth and available and functional on Enterprise
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select or identify a Growth-plan tenant and an Enterprise-plan tenant for comparison; Open and use the Recurring PO capability to configure an automatic PO-generation schedule; Assert that Recurring PO is absent or refused on Growth and available and functional on Enterprise

args.need: sign in as the buyer on the Growth and Enterprise tenants, attempt to configure Recurring PO auto-generation on each, and verify that Growth refuses or omits the capability while Enterprise allows the same workflow

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch by plan or operate and observe the Recurring PO capability.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash or server error after the tester completes the plan comparison.
